## DFA Approach Alternative

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(MASS)

BARREN_LABEL <- "Barren"
FOREST_LABEL <- "Macro_Forest"
predictors   <- c("ACI", "NDSI", "AEI", "ADI")
type_col     <- "TYPE"

# Prep data
keep_rows          <- complete.cases(all_data[, c(predictors, type_col)])
habitat_model_data <- all_data[keep_rows, ]
habitat_model_data[[type_col]] <- factor(
  habitat_model_data[[type_col]],
  levels = c(BARREN_LABEL, FOREST_LABEL)
)

cat("Total rows used:", nrow(habitat_model_data), "\n")
cat("Class counts:\n")
print(table(habitat_model_data[[type_col]]))

# Train LDA
habitat_lda_model <- lda(
  TYPE ~ ACI + NDSI + AEI + ADI,
  data = habitat_model_data
)

cat("\n--- LDA Model Summary ---\n")
print(habitat_lda_model)

# Training predictions & confusion matrix
habitat_lda_pred <- predict(habitat_lda_model, newdata = habitat_model_data)

stopifnot(length(habitat_lda_pred$class) == nrow(habitat_model_data))

conf_mat  <- table(Actual = habitat_model_data[[type_col]], Predicted = habitat_lda_pred$class)
conf_rate <- prop.table(conf_mat, margin = 1)

cat("\n--- Confusion Matrix (Counts) ---\n")
print(conf_mat)
cat("\n--- Confusion Matrix (Predicted Rates) ---\n")
print(round(conf_rate, 3))

misclass_rate <- 1 - sum(diag(conf_mat)) / sum(conf_mat)
cat("\nMisclassification Rate:", round(misclass_rate, 7), "\n")
cat("(JMP SVM reference:      0.2158539)\n")

# Leave-one-out cross validation
habitat_lda_cv <- lda(
  TYPE ~ ACI + NDSI + AEI + ADI,
  data = habitat_model_data,
  CV   = TRUE
)

cv_conf_mat  <- table(Actual = habitat_model_data[[type_col]], Predicted = habitat_lda_cv$class)
cv_conf_rate <- prop.table(cv_conf_mat, margin = 1)
cv_misclass  <- 1 - sum(diag(cv_conf_mat)) / sum(cv_conf_mat)

cat("\n--- LOO-CV Confusion Matrix (Counts) ---\n")
print(cv_conf_mat)
cat("\n--- LOO-CV Confusion Matrix (Rates) ---\n")
print(round(cv_conf_rate, 3))
cat("LOO-CV Misclassification Rate:", round(cv_misclass, 7), "\n")

# Extract posterior probabilities for downstream use
prob_barren_lda <- habitat_lda_pred$posterior[, "Barren"]
```

```{r}
library(MASS)

# CCA
cca_lda_model <- lda(TYPE ~ ACI + NDSI, data = cca_clean_data)
cca_lda_pred  <- predict(cca_lda_model, newdata = cca_clean_data)

conf_mat <- table(Actual = cca_clean_data$TYPE, Predicted = cca_lda_pred$class)
print(conf_mat)
cat("Misclassification Rate:", 1 - sum(diag(conf_mat)) / sum(conf_mat), "\n")

# Bare Rock
rock_lda_model <- lda(TYPE ~ ACI + NDSI, data = rock_clean_data)
rock_lda_pred  <- predict(rock_lda_model, newdata = rock_clean_data)

conf_mat <- table(Actual = rock_clean_data$TYPE, Predicted = rock_lda_pred$class)
print(conf_mat)
cat("Misclassification Rate:", 1 - sum(diag(conf_mat)) / sum(conf_mat), "\n")

# Kelp
kelp_lda_model <- lda(TYPE ~ ACI + NDSI, data = kelp_clean_data)
kelp_lda_pred  <- predict(kelp_lda_model, newdata = kelp_clean_data)

conf_mat <- table(Actual = kelp_clean_data$TYPE, Predicted = kelp_lda_pred$class)
print(conf_mat)
cat("Misclassification Rate:", 1 - sum(diag(conf_mat)) / sum(conf_mat), "\n")
```

```{r}
library(MASS)

# Train urchin LDA models

# CCA
cca_lda_model <- lda(TYPE ~ ACI + NDSI, data = cca_clean_data)

cca_lda_train_pred <- predict(cca_lda_model, newdata = cca_clean_data)
cca_lda_conf_mat   <- table(Actual = cca_clean_data$TYPE, Predicted = cca_lda_train_pred$class)
cca_lda_conf_rate  <- prop.table(cca_lda_conf_mat, margin = 1)
cat("--- CCA LDA ---\n")
print(cca_lda_conf_mat)
print(round(cca_lda_conf_rate, 3))
cat("Misclassification Rate:", 1 - sum(diag(cca_lda_conf_mat)) / sum(cca_lda_conf_mat), "\n\n")

# LOO-CV
cca_lda_cv <- lda(TYPE ~ ACI + NDSI, data = cca_clean_data, CV = TRUE)
cca_cv_conf <- table(Actual = cca_clean_data$TYPE, Predicted = cca_lda_cv$class)
cat("CCA LOO-CV Misclassification Rate:", 1 - sum(diag(cca_cv_conf)) / sum(cca_cv_conf), "\n\n")

# Bare Rock
rock_lda_model <- lda(TYPE ~ ACI + NDSI, data = rock_clean_data)

rock_lda_train_pred <- predict(rock_lda_model, newdata = rock_clean_data)
rock_lda_conf_mat   <- table(Actual = rock_clean_data$TYPE, Predicted = rock_lda_train_pred$class)
rock_lda_conf_rate  <- prop.table(rock_lda_conf_mat, margin = 1)
cat("--- Bare Rock LDA ---\n")
print(rock_lda_conf_mat)
print(round(rock_lda_conf_rate, 3))
cat("Misclassification Rate:", 1 - sum(diag(rock_lda_conf_mat)) / sum(rock_lda_conf_mat), "\n\n")

# LOO-CV
rock_lda_cv <- lda(TYPE ~ ACI + NDSI, data = rock_clean_data, CV = TRUE)
rock_cv_conf <- table(Actual = rock_clean_data$TYPE, Predicted = rock_lda_cv$class)
cat("Rock LOO-CV Misclassification Rate:", 1 - sum(diag(rock_cv_conf)) / sum(rock_cv_conf), "\n\n")

# Kelp
kelp_lda_model <- lda(TYPE ~ ACI + NDSI, data = kelp_clean_data)

kelp_lda_train_pred <- predict(kelp_lda_model, newdata = kelp_clean_data)
kelp_lda_conf_mat   <- table(Actual = kelp_clean_data$TYPE, Predicted = kelp_lda_train_pred$class)
kelp_lda_conf_rate  <- prop.table(kelp_lda_conf_mat, margin = 1)
cat("--- Kelp LDA ---\n")
print(kelp_lda_conf_mat)
print(round(kelp_lda_conf_rate, 3))
cat("Misclassification Rate:", 1 - sum(diag(kelp_lda_conf_mat)) / sum(kelp_lda_conf_mat), "\n\n")

# LOO-CV
kelp_lda_cv <- lda(TYPE ~ ACI + NDSI, data = kelp_clean_data, CV = TRUE)
kelp_cv_conf <- table(Actual = kelp_clean_data$TYPE, Predicted = kelp_lda_cv$class)
cat("Kelp LOO-CV Misclassification Rate:", 1 - sum(diag(kelp_cv_conf)) / sum(kelp_cv_conf), "\n\n")

# Predict all three onto full habitat_model_data
cca_probs_lda_full  <- predict(cca_lda_model,
                                newdata = data.frame(ACI  = habitat_model_data$ACI,
                                                     NDSI = habitat_model_data$NDSI))$posterior[, "URCHIN_CCA"]

rock_probs_lda_full <- predict(rock_lda_model,
                                newdata = data.frame(ACI  = as.numeric(habitat_model_data$ACI),
                                                     NDSI = as.numeric(habitat_model_data$NDSI)))$posterior[, "URCHINS_BARE_ROCK"]

kelp_probs_lda_full <- predict(kelp_lda_model,
                                newdata = data.frame(ACI  = habitat_model_data$ACI,
                                                     NDSI = habitat_model_data$NDSI))$posterior[, "URCHIN_KELP"]

# PCA on three urchin LDA probabilities
urchin_prob_lda_df <- data.frame(
  cca_prob  = cca_probs_lda_full,
  rock_prob = rock_probs_lda_full,
  kelp_prob = kelp_probs_lda_full
)

urchin_lda_pca <- prcomp(urchin_prob_lda_df, scale. = TRUE)
cat("PCA variance explained:\n")
print(summary(urchin_lda_pca)$importance)

# Extract PC1
pc1_lda <- urchin_lda_pca$x[, "PC1"]

# Regression against habitat LDA probability
lm_pc1_lda <- lm(prob_barren_lda ~ pc1_lda)
cat("\n--- PC1 vs Habitat LDA Probability Regression ---\n")
print(summary(lm_pc1_lda))

# Build plot dataframe
pc1_lda_df <- data.frame(
  pc1         = pc1_lda,
  prob_barren = prob_barren_lda,
  SITE        = habitat_model_data$SITE,
  TYPE        = habitat_model_data$TYPE
)

# Plot
ggplot(pc1_lda_df, aes(x = pc1, y = prob_barren)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = SITE), alpha = 0.2, size = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(aes(color = SITE, group = SITE), method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black", se = TRUE, linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate("text",
           x     = min(pc1_lda_df$pc1),
           y     = max(pc1_lda_df$prob_barren),
           label = paste0("R² = ", round(summary(lm_pc1_lda)$r.squared, 3),
                          ", P < 0.0001"),
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1.5, size = 4.5) +
 scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Harris_Island"  = "red",
    "Samsing_Cove"   = "orange",
    "Sandy_Cove"     = "pink",
    "Battery_Island" = "blue",
    "Crow_Island"    = "purple",
    "Middle_Island"  = "green"
  )) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x     = "More Urchin Noise (PC1)",
    y     = "Probability of Assignment as Urchin Barrens (LDA)",
    color = "Site"
  ) +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"))
```

## PC1 with different fits

```{r}
library(patchwork)

# Linear
p_linear <- ggplot(pc1_df, aes(x = pc1, y = prob_barren)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.8, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black", se = TRUE, linewidth = 1) +
  annotate("text", x = min(pc1_df$pc1), y = max(pc1_df$prob_barren),
           label = paste0("Linear | R² = ", round(summary(lm_pc1)$r.squared, 3)),
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1.5, size = 3.5) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "Linear", x = "More Urchin Noise (PC1)", y = "P(Barren)")

# Loess
p_loess <- ggplot(pc1_df, aes(x = pc1, y = prob_barren)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.8, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", color = "black", se = TRUE, linewidth = 1) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "LOESS", x = "More Urchin Noise (PC1)", y = "P(Barren)")

# Quadratic
lm_quad <- lm(prob_barren ~ poly(pc1, 2), data = pc1_df)
p_quad <- ggplot(pc1_df, aes(x = pc1, y = prob_barren)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.8, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ poly(x, 2), color = "black", se = TRUE, linewidth = 1) +
  annotate("text", x = min(pc1_df$pc1), y = max(pc1_df$prob_barren),
           label = paste0("Quadratic | R² = ", round(summary(lm_quad)$r.squared, 3)),
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1.5, size = 3.5) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "Quadratic", x = "More Urchin Noise (PC1)", y = "P(Barren)")

# Cubic
lm_cubic <- lm(prob_barren ~ poly(pc1, 3), data = pc1_df)
p_cubic <- ggplot(pc1_df, aes(x = pc1, y = prob_barren)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.8, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ poly(x, 3), color = "black", se = TRUE, linewidth = 1) +
  annotate("text", x = min(pc1_df$pc1), y = max(pc1_df$prob_barren),
           label = paste0("Cubic | R² = ", round(summary(lm_cubic)$r.squared, 3)),
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1.5, size = 3.5) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "Cubic", x = "More Urchin Noise (PC1)", y = "P(Barren)")

# Exponential
lm_exp <- lm(log(prob_barren + 0.001) ~ pc1, data = pc1_df)
p_exp <- ggplot(pc1_df, aes(x = pc1, y = prob_barren)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.8, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_smooth(method = "glm", method.args = list(family = gaussian(link = "log")),
              color = "black", se = TRUE, linewidth = 1) +
  annotate("text", x = min(pc1_df$pc1), y = max(pc1_df$prob_barren),
           label = paste0("Exponential | R² = ", round(summary(lm_exp)$r.squared, 3)),
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1.5, size = 3.5) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "Exponential", x = "More Urchin Noise (PC1)", y = "P(Barren)")

# Logistic
lm_logistic <- glm(prob_barren ~ pc1, data = pc1_df, family = quasibinomial())
p_logistic <- ggplot(pc1_df, aes(x = pc1, y = prob_barren)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.8, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_smooth(method = "glm", method.args = list(family = quasibinomial()),
              color = "black", se = TRUE, linewidth = 1) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "Logistic", x = "More Urchin Noise (PC1)", y = "P(Barren)")

# Combine
(p_linear + p_loess) / (p_quad + p_cubic) / (p_exp + p_logistic)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Fit biexponential using nls
# Need good starting values or it won't converge
biexp_fit <- nls(
  prob_barren ~ a * exp(b * pc1) + c * exp(d * pc1),
  data  = pc1_df,
  start = list(a = 0.5, b = 0.1, c = 0.5, d = -0.1),
  control = nls.control(maxiter = 200)
)

summary(biexp_fit)

# R² for nls (not automatic, calculate manually)
ss_res <- sum(residuals(biexp_fit)^2)
ss_tot <- sum((pc1_df$prob_barren - mean(pc1_df$prob_barren))^2)
r2_biexp <- 1 - ss_res / ss_tot
cat("Biexponential R²:", round(r2_biexp, 3), "\n")

# Plot
pc1_range <- seq(min(pc1_df$pc1), max(pc1_df$pc1), length.out = 500)
biexp_pred <- predict(biexp_fit, newdata = data.frame(pc1 = pc1_range))
biexp_line <- data.frame(pc1 = pc1_range, prob_barren = biexp_pred)

ggplot(pc1_df, aes(x = pc1, y = prob_barren)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.8, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_line(data = biexp_line, aes(x = pc1, y = prob_barren),
            color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
  annotate("text",
           x     = min(pc1_df$pc1),
           y     = max(pc1_df$prob_barren),
           label = paste0("Biexponential | R² = ", round(r2_biexp, 3)),
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1.5, size = 4) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "Biexponential Fit",
    x     = "More Urchin Noise (PC1)",
    y     = "Probability of Assignment as Urchin Barrens (SVM)"
  )
```

```{r}
# Simple exponential
exp_fit <- nls(
  prob_barren ~ a * exp(b * pc1),
  data    = pc1_df,
  start   = list(a = 0.3, b = 0.1),
  control = nls.control(maxiter = 500, minFactor = 1e-10)
)

ss_res  <- sum(residuals(exp_fit)^2)
ss_tot  <- sum((pc1_df$prob_barren - mean(pc1_df$prob_barren))^2)
r2_exp  <- 1 - ss_res / ss_tot
cat("Simple exponential R²:", round(r2_exp, 3), "\n")

pc1_range <- seq(min(pc1_df$pc1), max(pc1_df$pc1), length.out = 500)
exp_pred  <- predict(exp_fit, newdata = data.frame(pc1 = pc1_range))
exp_line  <- data.frame(pc1 = pc1_range, prob_barren = exp_pred)

ggplot(pc1_df, aes(x = pc1, y = prob_barren)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2, size = 0.8, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_line(data = exp_line, aes(x = pc1, y = prob_barren),
            color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
  annotate("text",
           x     = min(pc1_df$pc1),
           y     = max(pc1_df$prob_barren),
           label = paste0("Exponential | R² = ", round(r2_exp, 3)),
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1.5, size = 4) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "More Urchin Noise (PC1)",
    y = "Probability of Assignment as Urchin Barrens (SVM)"
  )
```

```{r}
# Fit exponential with hour as additional predictor
exp_hour_fit <- nls(
  prob_barren ~ a * exp(b * pc1 + c * HOUR_UTC),
  data    = pc1_df,
  start   = list(a = 0.3, b = 0.1, c = 0.01),
  control = nls.control(maxiter = 500, minFactor = 1e-10)
)

summary(exp_hour_fit)

ss_res      <- sum(residuals(exp_hour_fit)^2)
ss_tot      <- sum((pc1_df$prob_barren - mean(pc1_df$prob_barren))^2)
r2_exp_hour <- 1 - ss_res / ss_tot
cat("Exponential with hour R²:", round(r2_exp_hour, 3), "\n")

# Create prediction grid over PC1 and hour ranges
pc1_range  <- seq(min(pc1_df$pc1), max(pc1_df$pc1), length.out = 200)
hour_range <- seq(0, 23, by = 1)
pred_grid  <- expand.grid(pc1 = pc1_range, HOUR_UTC = hour_range)
pred_grid$prob_barren <- predict(exp_hour_fit, newdata = pred_grid)

# Plot with hour colored points and fitted lines per hour
ggplot(pc1_df, aes(x = pc1, y = prob_barren, color = HOUR_UTC)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2, size = 0.8) +
  geom_line(data = pred_grid %>% filter(HOUR_UTC %in% c(0:23)),
            aes(x = pc1, y = prob_barren, group = HOUR_UTC),
            linewidth = 1, inherit.aes = FALSE,
            color = c("navy", "cyan", "gold", "red")[
              match(pred_grid %>% filter(HOUR_UTC %in% c(0:23)) %>% pull(HOUR_UTC),
                    c(0:23))]) +
  scale_color_gradientn(
    colors = c("navy", "steelblue", "cyan", "gold", "orange", "red", "purple", "navy"),
    values = scales::rescale(c(0:23)),
    name   = "Hour of Day (UTC)"
  ) +
  annotate("text",
           x     = min(pc1_df$pc1),
           y     = max(pc1_df$prob_barren),
           label = paste0("Exp + Hour | R² = ", round(r2_exp_hour, 3)),
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1.5, size = 4) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "More Urchin Noise (PC1)",
    y = "Probability of Assignment as Urchin Barrens (SVM)"
  )
```

## RF Approach

```{r}
# Random Forest replacing the SVM
library(randomForest)

BARREN_LABEL <- "Barren"
FOREST_LABEL <- "Macro_Forest"
predictors   <- c("ACI", "NDSI", "AEI", "ADI")
type_col     <- "TYPE"

# Prep data
keep_rows  <- complete.cases(all_data[, c(predictors, type_col)])
habitat_model_data <- all_data[keep_rows, ]
habitat_model_data[[type_col]] <- factor(habitat_model_data[[type_col]],
                                  levels = c(BARREN_LABEL, FOREST_LABEL))
cat("Total rows used:", nrow(habitat_model_data), "\n")
cat("Class counts:\n")
print(table(habitat_model_data[[type_col]]))

# Train Random Forest
set.seed(42)   # for reproducibility
habitat_rf_model <- randomForest(
  TYPE ~ ACI + NDSI + AEI + ADI,
  data       = habitat_model_data,
  ntree      = 500,
  mtry       = 2,          # default for classification is floor(sqrt(#predictors)) = 2
  importance = TRUE
)

cat("\n--- Model Summary ---\n")
cat("Number of trees:         ", habitat_rf_model$ntree, "\n")
cat("Variables tried per split:", habitat_rf_model$mtry, "\n")
cat("OOB error rate:          ", round(habitat_rf_model$err.rate[habitat_rf_model$ntree, "OOB"], 7), "\n")

cat("\n--- Variable Importance ---\n")
print(round(importance(habitat_rf_model), 3))

# 3. Training predictions & confusion matrix
train_pred <- predict(habitat_rf_model, newdata = habitat_model_data)
stopifnot(length(train_pred) == nrow(habitat_model_data))
conf_mat  <- table(Actual = habitat_model_data[[type_col]], Predicted = train_pred)
conf_rate <- prop.table(conf_mat, margin = 1)
cat("\n--- Confusion Matrix (Counts) ---\n")
print(conf_mat)
cat("\n--- Confusion Matrix (Predicted Rates) ---\n")
print(round(conf_rate, 3))
misclass_rate <- 1 - sum(diag(conf_mat)) / sum(conf_mat)
cat("\nTraining Misclassification Rate:", round(misclass_rate, 7), "\n")
cat("(JMP reference:                  0.2158539)\n")
```

```{r}
library(randomForest)

BARREN_LABEL <- "Barren"
FOREST_LABEL <- "Macro_Forest"
predictors   <- c("ACI", "NDSI", "AEI", "ADI")
type_col     <- "TYPE"

# Prep data
keep_rows <- complete.cases(all_data[, c(predictors, type_col)])
habitat_model_data <- all_data[keep_rows, ]
habitat_model_data[[type_col]] <- factor(habitat_model_data[[type_col]],
                                  levels = c(BARREN_LABEL, FOREST_LABEL))
cat("Total rows used:", nrow(habitat_model_data), "\n")
cat("Class counts:\n")
print(table(habitat_model_data[[type_col]]))

rf_formula <- TYPE ~ ACI + NDSI + AEI + ADI
NTREE <- 500
MTRY  <- 2

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. OOB error (free, built into the full-data model)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(42)
habitat_rf_model <- randomForest(rf_formula, data = habitat_model_data,
                                 ntree = NTREE, mtry = MTRY, importance = TRUE)
oob_rate <- habitat_rf_model$err.rate[NTREE, "OOB"]

cat("\nOOB (out-of-bag) evaluation\n")
cat("OOB confusion matrix:\n")
print(habitat_rf_model$confusion)
cat("OOB misclassification rate:", round(oob_rate, 7), "\n")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Single train / validation holdout (JMP-style validation column)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(42)
n <- nrow(habitat_model_data)
train_idx  <- sample(seq_len(n), size = floor(0.7 * n))   # 70/30 split
train_data <- habitat_model_data[train_idx, ]
valid_data <- habitat_model_data[-train_idx, ]

holdout_model <- randomForest(rf_formula, data = train_data,
                              ntree = NTREE, mtry = MTRY)
valid_pred <- predict(holdout_model, newdata = valid_data)
conf_holdout <- table(Actual = valid_data[[type_col]], Predicted = valid_pred)
holdout_rate <- 1 - sum(diag(conf_holdout)) / sum(conf_holdout)

cat("\nHoldout (30% validation) evaluation\n")
cat("Confusion matrix (counts):\n")
print(conf_holdout)
cat("Confusion matrix (predicted rates):\n")
print(round(prop.table(conf_holdout, margin = 1), 3))
cat("Validation misclassification rate:", round(holdout_rate, 7), "\n")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. k-fold cross-validation (most robust comparison)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(42)
k <- 5
folds <- sample(rep(seq_len(k), length.out = n))
cv_pred <- rep(NA_character_, n)

for (f in seq_len(k)) {
  fold_train <- habitat_model_data[folds != f, ]
  test_rows  <- which(folds == f)
  fold_model <- randomForest(rf_formula, data = fold_train,
                             ntree = NTREE, mtry = MTRY)
  cv_pred[test_rows] <- as.character(
    predict(fold_model, newdata = habitat_model_data[test_rows, ])
  )
}
cv_pred <- factor(cv_pred, levels = levels(habitat_model_data[[type_col]]))

conf_cv <- table(Actual = habitat_model_data[[type_col]], Predicted = cv_pred)
cv_rate <- 1 - sum(diag(conf_cv)) / sum(conf_cv)

cat("\n=== ", k, "-fold cross-validation evaluation ===\n", sep = "")
cat("Confusion matrix (counts):\n")
print(conf_cv)
cat("Confusion matrix (predicted rates):\n")
print(round(prop.table(conf_cv, margin = 1), 3))
cat("CV misclassification rate:", round(cv_rate, 7), "\n")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Summary vs references
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n--- Error rate summary ---\n")
cat("OOB:              ", round(oob_rate, 7), "\n")
cat("Holdout (30%):    ", round(holdout_rate, 7), "\n")
cat(sprintf("%d-fold CV:        %s\n", k, round(cv_rate, 7)))
cat("JMP SVM reference: 0.2158539\n")
```

```{r}
# Confusion matrix summary

  cat(sprintf("  %-15s  %-20s  %-20s  %-10s\n",
              lv,

              paste0(rc[FOREST_LABEL], " (", round(rr[FOREST_LABEL], 3), ")"),
              round(1 - rr[lv], 3)))
```

```{r}
{r}
library(randomForest)

# ===============================================================
# Reusable: train an urchin-activity random forest for one substrate
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# csv_path      : path to the substrate's indices CSV
# urchin_label  : the raw TYPE string that means "urchin present"
#                 (e.g. "URCHIN_CCA")
# no_urchin_out : the label to assign to every non-urchin row
#                 (e.g. "NO_URCHIN_CCA")
# ntree, mtry   : RF settings (defaults: 500 trees, mtry = 1 for 2 predictors)
# k             : number of CV folds
# seed          : for reproducibility
# ===============================================================
run_urchin_rf <- function(csv_path,
                          urchin_label,
                          no_urchin_out,
                          ntree = 500,
                          mtry  = 1,
                          k     = 5,
                          seed  = 123) {

  substrate <- deparse(substitute(csv_path))  # cosmetic; overwritten below if named

  # --- Read & build clean data -------------------------------
  raw <- read.csv(csv_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  raw$TYPE <- trimws(raw$TYPE)

  clean <- data.frame(
    TYPE = ifelse(raw$TYPE == urchin_label, urchin_label, no_urchin_out),
    ACI  = as.numeric(raw$ACI),
    NDSI = as.numeric(raw$NDSI)
  )
  clean <- na.omit(clean)
  clean$TYPE <- factor(clean$TYPE, levels = c(urchin_label, no_urchin_out))

  cat("\n==============================================\n")
  cat("Substrate labels:", urchin_label, "vs", no_urchin_out, "\n")
  cat("Total rows used: ", nrow(clean), "\n")
  cat("Class counts:\n")
  print(table(clean$TYPE))

  # Guard: both classes must be present, or RF can't run
  if (nlevels(droplevels(clean$TYPE)) < 2) {
    stop("Only one class present after cleaning — check that '",
         urchin_label, "' matches the raw TYPE values exactly.")
  }

  # --- Train RF on full data (gives OOB) ---------------------
  set.seed(seed)
  rf <- randomForest(TYPE ~ ACI + NDSI, data = clean,
                     ntree = ntree, mtry = mtry, importance = TRUE)

  oob_rate <- rf$err.rate[ntree, "OOB"]
  oob_pred <- predict(rf)                       # OOB class predictions
  conf_mat  <- table(Actual = clean$TYPE, Predicted = oob_pred)
  conf_rate <- prop.table(conf_mat, margin = 1)

  cat("\n--- Model Summary ---\n")
  cat("Number of trees:          ", ntree, "\n")
  cat("Variables tried per split:", mtry, "\n")
  cat("OOB error rate:           ", round(oob_rate, 7), "\n")

  cat("\n--- Variable Importance ---\n")
  print(round(importance(rf), 3))

  cat("\n--- OOB Confusion Matrix (Counts) ---\n")
  print(conf_mat)
  cat("\n--- OOB Confusion Matrix (Predicted Rates) ---\n")
  print(round(conf_rate, 3))

  # --- 5-fold CV (analog to ksvm cross = k) ------------------
  set.seed(seed)
  n <- nrow(clean)
  folds   <- sample(rep(seq_len(k), length.out = n))
  cv_pred <- factor(rep(NA, n), levels = levels(clean$TYPE))
  for (f in seq_len(k)) {
    fold_model <- randomForest(TYPE ~ ACI + NDSI,
                               data = clean[folds != f, ],
                               ntree = ntree, mtry = mtry)
    cv_pred[folds == f] <- predict(fold_model, newdata = clean[folds == f, ])
  }
  cv_rate <- mean(cv_pred != clean$TYPE)

  cat("\n5-fold CV error:   ", round(cv_rate, 7), "\n")
  cat("5-fold CV accuracy:", round(1 - cv_rate, 7), "\n")

  # --- Return everything for later comparison ----------------
  invisible(list(
    model         = rf,
    data          = clean,
    n             = n,
    class_counts  = table(clean$TYPE),
    oob_rate      = oob_rate,
    oob_conf_mat  = conf_mat,
    oob_conf_rate = conf_rate,
    cv_rate       = cv_rate,
    importance    = importance(rf)
  ))
}

# ===============================================================
# Run all three substrates through identical code
# ===============================================================
base <- "/Users/aminashenasa/soundscapes_data/data/acoustic_data/filtered_data/"

cca_rf <- run_urchin_rf(
  paste0(base, "Sage_Constraints_Experiment_CCA Urchin Indices.csv"),
  urchin_label  = "URCHIN_CCA",
  no_urchin_out = "NO_URCHIN_CCA"
)

# --- Kelp: EDIT these to match the kelp CSV's exact filename & TYPE string ---
kelp_rf <- run_urchin_rf(
  paste0(base, "Sage_Constraints_Experiment_Kelp Urchin Indices.csv"),
  urchin_label  = "URCHIN_KELP",
  no_urchin_out = "NO URCHIN_KELP"
)

# --- Bare rock: EDIT these to match the bare-rock CSV's filename & TYPE string ---
bare_rf <- run_urchin_rf(
  paste0(base, "Sage_Constraints_Experiment_Bare Rock Urchin Indices.csv"),
  urchin_label  = "URCHINS_BARE ROCK",
  no_urchin_out = "NO URCHINS_BARE ROCK"
)

# ===============================================================
# Comparison table across substrates
# ===============================================================
rf_summary <- data.frame(
  Substrate    = c("CCA", "Kelp", "Bare rock"),
  N            = c(cca_rf$n, kelp_rf$n, bare_rf$n),
  OOB_error    = round(c(cca_rf$oob_rate, kelp_rf$oob_rate, bare_rf$oob_rate), 4),
  OOB_accuracy = round(1 - c(cca_rf$oob_rate, kelp_rf$oob_rate, bare_rf$oob_rate), 4),
  CV_error     = round(c(cca_rf$cv_rate, kelp_rf$cv_rate, bare_rf$cv_rate), 4),
  CV_accuracy  = round(1 - c(cca_rf$cv_rate, kelp_rf$cv_rate, bare_rf$cv_rate), 4)
)
cat("\n=== Random forest summary across substrates ===\n")
print(rf_summary, row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(rf_summary, "urchin_activity_rf_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(ggrepel)

# Helper function to get R² and p for each variable
get_stats <- function(x, y) {
  fit <- summary(lm(y ~ x))
  r2  <- round(fit$r.squared, 3)
  p   <- round(fit$coefficients[2, 4], 3)
  paste0("R² = ", r2, ", p = ", p)
}

make_panel <- function(data, xvar, xlabel) {
  stats_label <- get_stats(data[[xvar]], data$mean_prob)
  ggplot(data, aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = mean_prob, color = TYPE)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black", se = TRUE, linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_text_repel(aes(label = SITE), size = 2.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
    annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = stats_label,
             hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 3.5) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Barren" = "red", "Macro_Forest" = "blue")) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(x = xlabel, y = "SVM probability (Barren)", color = "Habitat")
}

p_red_density  <- make_panel(regression_data, "red_urchin_density",  "Red urchin density (m²)")
p_red_biomass  <- make_panel(regression_data, "red_urchin_biomass",  "Red urchin biomass (m²)")
p_green_density <- make_panel(regression_data, "green_urchin_density", "Green urchin density (m²)")
p_stipe        <- make_panel(regression_data, "stipe_density",        "Macrocystis stipe density (m²)")

svm_ecological_combined <- (p_red_density + p_red_biomass) / (p_green_density + p_stipe) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(title = "SVM Probability vs Ecological Variables") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave("SVM Probability vs Ecological Variables.png", svm_ecological_combined,
       width = 11, height = 5.2, dpi = 30
```

```{r}
# Step 1 — predict all three urchin RFs onto full habitat_model_data

newdata_full <- data.frame(
  ACI  = as.numeric(habitat_model_data$ACI),
  NDSI = as.numeric(habitat_model_data$NDSI)
)

cca_probs_full  <- predict(cca_rf$model,  newdata = newdata_full, type = "prob")[, "URCHIN_CCA"]

rock_probs_full <- predict(bare_rf$model, newdata = newdata_full, type = "prob")[, "URCHINS_BARE ROCK"]
# Step 2 — combine and run PCA
urchin_prob_df <- data.frame(
  cca_prob  = cca_probs_full,
  rock_prob = rock_probs_full,
  kelp_prob = kelp_probs_full
)
# guard: PCA can't handle NA rows
urchin_prob_df <- urchin_prob_df[complete.cases(urchin_prob_df), ]

urchin_pca <- prcomp(urchin_prob_df, scale. = TRUE)
summary(urchin_pca)
print(urchin_pca$rotation)   # <-- check PC1 loadings before negating (see note)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 3 — extract PC1 (sign chosen so higher = more urchin noise)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
pc1_scores <- urchin_pca$x[, "PC1"]
# Negate ONLY if the loadings show urchin prob loads negative on PC1:
# pc1_scores <- -pc1_scores

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 4 — habitat RF barren probabilities (OOB, consistent w/ pipeline)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
prob_barren_all <- predict(habitat_rf_model, type = "prob")[, "Barren"]

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 5 — regress and plot
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
pc1_df <- data.frame(pc1 = pc1_scores, prob_barren = prob_barren_all)

lm_pc1 <- lm(prob_barren ~ pc1, data = pc1_df)
summary(lm_pc1)

ggplot(pc1_df, aes(x = pc1, y = prob_barren)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "steelblue", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1) +
  annotate("text",
           x = min(pc1_df$pc1), y = max(pc1_df$prob_barren),
           label = paste0("R² = ", round(summary(lm_pc1)$r.squared, 3),
                          ", P = ", format(summary(lm_pc1)$coefficients[2, 4],
                                           scientific = TRUE, digits = 2)),
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1.5, size = 4.5) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "More Urchin Noise (PC1)",
       y = "Probability of Assignment as Urchin Barrens (Random Forest)") +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"))
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# PC1 (urchin noise) vs red urchin density, at site level
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

# Attach PC1 back to the habitat rows.
# IMPORTANT: this requires pc1_scores to be aligned 1:1 with
# habitat_model_data rows. If you filtered NAs during PCA, see the note below.
stopifnot(length(pc1_scores) == nrow(habitat_model_data))
habitat_model_data$pc1 <- pc1_scores

# Mean PC1 per site
pc1_by_site <- habitat_model_data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(site) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(mean_pc1 = mean(pc1, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(join_key = tolower(site))

# eco_data already has join_key from the earlier fix; if not, recreate it:
if (!"join_key" %in% names(eco_data)) {
  eco_data <- eco_data %>% dplyr::mutate(join_key = tolower(SITE))
}

pc1_reg_data <- dplyr::left_join(pc1_by_site, eco_data, by = "join_key")

# Confirm the join populated density before regressing
print(pc1_reg_data[, c("site", "mean_pc1", "red_urchin_density")])
colSums(is.na(pc1_reg_data[, c("mean_pc1", "red_urchin_density")]))

# Regression
pc1_urchin_model <- lm(mean_pc1 ~ red_urchin_density, data = pc1_reg_data)
cat("\n--- PC1 (urchin noise) vs red urchin density, n = 6 ---\n")
print(summary(pc1_urchin_model))

# Spearman companion (robust at n = 6)
print(cor.test(pc1_reg_data$red_urchin_density, pc1_reg_data$mean_pc1,
               method = "spearman"))

# Plot
p_pc1_urchin <- ggplot(pc1_reg_data, aes(x = red_urchin_density, y = mean_pc1)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, colour = "firebrick3", fill = "grey80") +
  geom_point(size = 3, colour = "black") +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = site), size = 3.5) +
  xlab(expression("Red urchin density (ind. m"^-2*")")) +
  ylab("Mean urchin-noise score (PC1)") +
  ggtitle("Site-level urchin acoustic signal vs. red urchin density (n = 6)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13)

print(p_pc1_urchin)
ggsave("urchin_pc1_vs_red_density.png", plot = p_pc1_urchin,
       width = 7, height = 6, dpi = 150)
```
